column3: Outdated in part ("if it's a token"): written 2021-09-24, when a token copy of a double-faced permanent copied only its face that was up and only permanents represented by transforming double-faced cards could transform (still so in the CR effective 2023-02-03). The CR effective 2023-04-14 (March of the Machine) added 707.8a: a token copy of a double-faced permanent is a double-faced token with both faces, which can transform, so a token copy of Enduring Angel transforms and its controller's life total becomes 3 (tests/rulings/r_residue_misc_2c_replacement.rs, enduring_angel_a_token_copy_is_double_faced_and_transforms). The rest (a single-faced permanent that became a copy can't transform, and its controller loses) is cited in that file. See docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md.
